clue.text: In capacity of chairperson, ultimately run supervisory body

parts.note: qua is the Latin-derived word meaning in the capacity of

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word chairperson

parts.note: to run is to go

explanation.surface: Someone acting as chair ends up running an oversight committee.
explanation.walkthrough: A QUANGO is a British term for a semi-independent public body funded by government.
explanation.definitionFit: A quasi-autonomous non-governmental organisation is a body that oversees some public function.

clue.text: Monetary estimate given in marks

definitions.meaning: a price given in advance for a job
words set within ... marks are cited from someone

explanation.definitionFit: A builder's price is one sense; a cited passage, set off by inverted commas, is the other.

clue.text: Medicine in advertisement — it can settle disturbed inside

indicators.note: settle, with inside, says the shuffled words settle within the advert
inside, with settle, places the shuffled words in the middle of the advert
disturbed means the words it can are jumbled

explanation.surface: An advert claims its remedy calms an upset stomach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Medicine' is the definition; the advert surface hides that 'settle' and 'inside' together signal the container.
explanation.definitionFit: An antacid is a remedy that neutralises stomach acid.

clue.text: Prison unsuitable for stone-throwers?

definitions.meaning: British military slang for an army jail
people in ... should not throw stones

explanation.definitionFit: It is British army slang for a military jail, and the proverb warns those living in glass not to throw stones.

clue.text: A key worker consuming food in plenty

indicators.note: consuming means the first group swallows the food, which goes inside it

parts.note: D is a musical key
an ant is the classic worker insect
a bun is a small item of food

explanation.surface: An important employee is eating plenty of food.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abundant exists in large quantity, just as things in plenty do.

clue.text: On which one can read the score when playing in the park

definitions.text: On which one can read the score when playing in the park

parts.words: On which one can read the score when playing in the park
parts.note: not a sports scoreboard but the raised platform where a brass band reads its music in a park

explanation.definitionFit: Park musicians perform their scores on this raised covered platform.

clue.text: Record part of score

definitions.meaning: a single written sign for a pitch in music

explanation.definitionFit: To jot down is to record; a musical score is made of written pitches.

clue.text: Surrounded by general anxiety about short time

indicators.note: about means the anxiety goes round the short time

parts.note: angst is a general feeling of dread
mo is short for moment

explanation.surface: Someone surrounded by widespread worry over a lack of time.
explanation.definitionFit: To be among others is to be surrounded by them.

clue.text: Earnest dedication for a Scot

definitions.meaning: an earnest is a pledge or sign of good faith
an inscription to a man named Ken, a typically Scottish name

explanation.definitionFit: An earnest is a pledge given as a sign; split, the word reads as a gift tag to Ken.

clue.text: Leading performer's mark of distinction

definitions.meaning: the headline actor in a show
an asterisk-like symbol awarded for merit

explanation.definitionFit: The lead in a show is its headliner, and an award symbol on a pupil's work signals merit.

clue.text: Striking appearance of Ishmael, for one

parts.note: workers who are striking are out
cast can mean a look or appearance, as in the cast of a face

explanation.surface: A remark on the dramatic look of the biblical Ishmael.
explanation.walkthrough: Ishmael, son of Abraham, was driven out into the desert, and the name came to mean a social exile.
explanation.definitionFit: Ishmael is the biblical archetype of a rejected exile, so he is an example.

clue.text: Be occupied on final broadcast

indicators.note: in an across clue on means the first piece is placed after the one it sits on, so it follows

parts.note: a net figure is the final one after deductions
to be occupied is to work

explanation.surface: Being busy on the last transmission of a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To network a programme is to transmit it across a chain of stations, so to broadcast it.

clue.text: Scans trees, perhaps, to find such a woman

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of the two words may be a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Searching family trees to track down a woman of a particular kind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'such a woman' refers back to the family trees: a forebear found by a genealogist.
explanation.definitionFit: A female forebear is exactly the kind of woman one finds by scanning family trees.

clue.text: Not in favour of court abandoning battle

indicators.note: abandoning means the word court is dropped from the battle's name

parts.note: Agincourt is the 1415 battle won by Henry V
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone opposed to a court abandoning a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: AGIN is a dialect word for against.
explanation.definitionFit: The dialect preposition means opposed, against.

clue.text: Flag-waving judge in trial gets one punishment cut

parts.note: a go is a try or trial
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: cut means the punishment loses its final letter

parts.note: the stick is corporal punishment

explanation.surface: A patriotic judge in a case receives a lighter sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: Jingoism is aggressive patriotism, the attitude of the flag-waver.

clue.text: Within a building, no exits?

definitions.meaning: split as ..., doors that only let you in

explanation.definitionFit: Being inside a building is being under cover rather than outside; the second reading jokes that all doors are entrances.

clue.text: Enlisted in military band, beats up Englishman

indicators.note: enlisted in means the reversed beats are taken into the band

parts.note: a sash is a band of cloth worn with military uniform

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to cane is to beat

explanation.surface: A recruit in the army band thrashes an Englishman.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the Scots term, often mocking, for an English person; 'military band' is not musicians but a sash.
explanation.definitionFit: Scots and Irish use the word, often mockingly, for an English person.

clue.text: Simple part in opera requiring a complicated attire

indicators.note: complicated means the letters of attire are tangled into a new order

explanation.surface: A simple operatic role needs an elaborate costume.
explanation.definitionFit: A little aria is a short, simple song for a solo voice in an opera.

clue.text: Consequences of new grass growing

definitions.meaning: a second crop of grass after mowing

explanation.definitionFit: The aftereffects of an event are its results; originally the word meant a second mowing of grass.

clue.text: Sailors lacking answer brought about one's downfall

indicators.note: brought about means turned round, so the shortened sailors are read backwards
lacking means the answer's abbreviation is dropped from the sailors

parts.note: seamen are sailors
one's is one is, I + S

explanation.surface: Sailors with no answer caused somebody to come to grief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' takes A out of SEAMEN to leave SEMEN; 'brought about' turns that into NEMES.
explanation.definitionFit: A nemesis is the agent of one's ruin, one's undoing.

clue.text: Islander's vote secured by male twins

indicators.note: secured by means the vote is held between the two males
twins means the male is given twice

parts.note: a man is a male
X is the cross marked on a ballot paper

explanation.surface: An island voter whose ballot is guarded by two brothers.
explanation.walkthrough: A MANXMAN comes from the Isle of Man, between Britain and Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the Isle of Man is an islander.

clue.text: In which one can get pointers to the game

definitions.text: In which one can get pointers to the game

parts.words: In which one can get pointers to the game
parts.note: pointers are gun dogs, and the game is shooting game: a light carriage built to carry sporting dogs to the shoot

explanation.definitionFit: A light two-wheeled carriage was originally built with a box for sporting dogs.

clue.text: One who doesn't believe it's time to stop a robbery

indicators.note: to stop means time plugs a robbery, sitting inside it

parts.note: a heist is a robbery

explanation.surface: Someone without faith says it is time to prevent a robbery.
explanation.definitionFit: An atheist denies the existence of God.

clue.text: Rabbit runs away from close companion

indicators.note: away from means runs leaves the companion

parts.note: a crony is a close friend
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A rabbit bolts from its best friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Cony is an old word for the rabbit or its fur.

clue.text: Delightful quality of Daily Mirror's leader

parts.note: a daily is a cleaning woman, a char

indicators.note: leader points to the opening letter of Mirror's

explanation.surface: A tabloid newspaper's editorial is praised for its appeal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Daily Mirror' looks like the tabloid's name, but Daily is a cleaner, a British term for someone who comes in to clean.
explanation.definitionFit: Appeal or attractiveness is a delightful quality.

clue.text: Benevolent type hopefully dropping coins into water?

definitions.meaning: someone who hopes others do well
a person who throws coins into a wishing well while making a wish

explanation.definitionFit: A person who wishes others well is kindly disposed; split, the word names one wishing at a well.

clue.text: With this singer about, indulge in high jinks

definitions.text: With this singer about, indulge in high jinks

parts.words: With this singer about, indulge in high jinks
parts.note: add the word about to the name of a songbird and you get a phrase for fooling around

explanation.definitionFit: The songbird gives a phrasal verb when followed by about, meaning to play the fool.

clue.text: Remarkable person's embarrassing mistake

annotationWithheld.why: Remarkable person's embarrassing mistake (4), as printed: ONER is a remarkable person, but no sense of it means an embarrassing mistake, and no wordplay gives it.

clue.text: Projectiles briefly put back in a compound

parts.note: ammo is short for ammunition, projectiles

indicators.note: put back means the little word in is read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Missiles, in short, are returned to a fortified enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: This pungent gas is a chemical compound of nitrogen and hydrogen.

clue.text: Set out in rainstorm to obtain wine

indicators.note: out means the letters are set out afresh in a different order

parts.note: a rainstorm is a downpour of rain

explanation.surface: Heading out into a downpour to fetch some wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' shuffles SET with RAIN to give the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Retsina is a Greek white wine flavoured with pine resin.

clue.text: It's sovereign territory, as a rule

definitions.text: It's sovereign territory, as a rule

parts.words: It's sovereign territory, as a rule
parts.note: a realm ruled by a sovereign, and also a form of rule in itself

explanation.definitionFit: A state headed by a king or queen is both a sovereign's territory and a system of rule.

clue.text: Put an end to tax once paid by church

parts.note: scot was an old tax, as in scot-free

explanation.surface: Abolishing a levy the church used to pay.
explanation.definitionFit: To scotch a plan or rumour is to stop it dead.
